texto:
A community garden is a piece of land gardened by a group of people from a neighborhood. You can find them in cities, often in parks or on empty lots. People work together to grow vegetables, fruits, and flowers. It is a wonderful way for people who live in apartments and do not have their own yard to connect with nature.

But these gardens offer more than just fresh food. They are a great way to meet neighbors and build a stronger community. People of all ages, from young children to older adults, can participate. They learn from each other about planting and taking care of the plants. This activity is also very good for mental health because spending time outdoors and working with your hands can reduce stress.

To join, a person or family usually pays a small annual fee for a small piece of land called a 'plot'. Members often share tools and responsibilities, like watering the entire garden on certain days. It’s a collaborative effort that makes the neighborhood more beautiful and healthy.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what is a key benefit of community gardens besides providing fresh food?

opciones.A: It allows people to sell vegetables for a profit.
opciones.B: It helps people build a stronger community.
opciones.C: It provides a place for professional gardeners to work.
opciones.D: It gives members free tools and seeds.
opciones.E: It teaches people how to cook healthy meals.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B porque el texto menciona explícitamente que los jardines comunitarios son una forma de fortalecer los lazos sociales. Dice: 'They are a great way to meet neighbors and build a stronger community'. The other options are incorrect. El texto no menciona que la gente venda verduras ('sell vegetables'). No dice que sea para jardineros profesionales ('professional gardeners'); de hecho, dice que la gente aprende allí. El texto indica que los miembros 'share tools' (comparten herramientas), no que son gratis ('free'). Finalmente, no se menciona nada sobre aprender a cocinar ('how to cook').

preguntas.pregunta: From the text, we can infer that participating in a community garden requires...

opciones.B: A large amount of money to join.
opciones.C: Living in a house with a large yard.
opciones.E: Working in the garden every single day.

preguntas.explicacion: La inferencia correcta es D. El texto no usa la palabra 'cooperation' directamente, pero la idea está presente. Menciona que la gente 'work together' (trabaja junta), 'share tools and responsibilities' (comparte herramientas y responsabilidades) y que es un 'collaborative effort' (esfuerzo colaborativo). This all implies that cooperation is necessary. Las otras opciones son incorrectas. A es incorrecta porque el texto dice que la gente 'learn from each other', lo que sugiere que no todos son expertos. B es incorrecta porque se menciona una 'small annual fee' (una pequeña cuota anual). C es incorrecta, ya que el texto dice que es especialmente bueno para la gente 'who live in apartments'. E no se puede inferir; el texto solo dice que los miembros tienen responsabilidades 'on certain days' (en ciertos días), no todos los días.
